areas.name: Indigenous and quilombola peoples
areas.reason: Some products protect ecosystems on which traditional populations depend, but the link is indirect and the focus is not traditional peoples; low impact.

areas.name: Sustainable cities
areas.reason: Green infrastructure, nature-based sanitation and drainage, and cycle paths relevant; moderate impact given a resource share of about one third.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: General objective directly aligned; about half of resources, most products direct (protected-area mosaic, wetland designation, green parks, education centres); high impact with nature-based solutions.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Ecosystem preservation acts as a natural barrier against floods, but effects are indirect and resources only indirectly linked; low impact.

areas.name: Water security
areas.reason: Interventions improve water quality and stormwater management via nature-based solutions, with a water-quality target; moderate impact given a small resource share of about 10%.

areas.name: Tourism
areas.reason: Ecotourism spaces, a specific objective and a sustainable-tourism indicator exist, but resources are only indirectly linked; low impact.

areas.name: Creative economy
areas.reason: A heritage museum product exists, but no targets on the area and the declared indicator cannot measure creative-economy or cultural impact; indicator used under environment.

areas.name: Sport
areas.reason: Linear parks include cycle paths and leisure space, but the focus is conservation and low-impact mobility; the cycling indicator was used under sustainable cities.

areas.name: Labor
areas.reason: Green-jobs objective is not reflected in programme actions; the related tourism objective was used under tourism.

areas.name: Transparency and participation
areas.reason: Community engagement centres deliver infrastructure only, with no permanent participation or governance mechanisms; indicator used under environment.

bonus.reason: Proponent claimed deforestation-combat and climate-emergency priorities, but only about half of resources fund aligned products, so full allocation was not shown.
Proponent did not state regional integration; NT marks it as not applicable.
